prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pick Your Pet Journey", "Choose whether to pick a pre-made pet companion or create your own custom desktop pet.", "Choose your companion path below", "Select Path"]
1: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Log in with your existing account to instantly sync your saved pets, progress, and custom accessories.", "Using the same account ensures your pets are never lost or reset."]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Create or sign into your account now so your pet stays active and synced across devices."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion Is Coming to Life", "Please stay tuned while we render your custom pet graphics and desk animations.", "Pet generation progress"]
4: ["Use well-lit photos with clear backgrounds for best pet generation results.", "For best results: clear lighting, full view of subject, high resolution."]
5: ["Next: Desktop Controls"]
6: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion an official name to complete the adoption.", "Pet Name", "Official Pet Companion"]
8: ["Choose Your Ideal Desktop Friend", "Explore different pet personalities, sounds, and animations before taking them home.", "Personality Options", "Preview Voice"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Here are quick tips to get started.", "Click pet to interact | Right-click for settings | Drag to reposition"]
